imgresize.drop: Drop a photo here, or click to choose one
imgresize.hint.bytes: It lowers the quality step by step until it fits, and shrinks the dimensions if that is still not enough.
imgresize.format.png: PNG — good for text and drawings
imgresize.status.idle: The photo stays in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere.
imgresize.default.name: photo
imgresize.say.ready: Pick a target and hit Resize.
imgresize.err.open: Could not open that photo. Try another file.
imgresize.say.overLimit: It did not get under your limit. Try WebP, or shrink the long side further.
